Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G4695; unblemished (physically or morally):--without spot, unspotted.
BiblicalUsage: Without spot is how Peter describes the blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish, and how James describes pure religion, keeping oneself unspotted from the world. Peter tells believers to be diligent to be found of Him in peace, without spot, and Paul charges Timothy to keep the commandment without spot until Christ appears.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the spotless Lamb is the reason spotless living is possible at all. We are not made clean by keeping ourselves apart, we are kept clean by the One who was never stained, and I hold that His purity is the pattern and the power for ours.
RelatedPeople: Simon Peter; James, Brother of the Lord; Paul
